recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No further FHIR core source work is needed for FHIR-37789 unless humans separately choose to reconsider the non-dragon R4/R5 redesign implementation note.
issue_request: FHIR-37789 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core ConceptMap request from the Vocabulary WG for R5 to remove the dragon/header box and text that told readers ConceptMap would be replaced by ConceptMap2 after that transition completed.
initial_application: No Jira-tagged FHIR-37789 source commit was found. Git history shows 9e9b97453f added the ConceptMap-to-ConceptMap2 dragon warning in 2021, 8623473ddf moved ConceptMap2 content into ConceptMap on 2022-07-18 while leaving that warning stale, and 033afec42b removed the five-line warning block from source/conceptmap/conceptmap-introduction.xml on 2022-08-10.
additional_context: ConceptMap is active in source/fhir.ini, so source/conceptmap is in current build scope. Current source/conceptmap contains no ConceptMap2, dragon macro, dragon image, or Here Be Dragons warning. The remaining R4/R5 implementation note in conceptmap-introduction.xml describes structural redesign details and is distinct from the removed transition header.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit because the requested source change has already been applied in the current authoritative ConceptMap source.

related_jiras.note: The broader ConceptMap2-to-ConceptMap replacement made the transition warning obsolete; it was used as context only and not independently decided.
